name: sg_stats_by_category
description: Retrieve email statistics for one or more categories between two dates, computed from the mail send log's category tags; matching historical category_stats records for the range are included. (GET /v3/categories/stats)

categories.description: The individual categories that you want retrieve statistics for. A comma-separated list or an array of category names.

start_date.description: The starting date of the statistics to retrieve. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: The end date of the statistics to retrieve. Defaults to today. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.
